subgate.goal: Generalize verified prebirth decomposition beyond disjoint pair-products using content-derived size-1 separators in the CNF primal graph.

proof_obligations: Bind the canonical CNF hash before decomposition.
Build the primal graph from actual co-occurrence of variables in clauses.
A separator is authorized only if deleting that variable increases the number of connected components.
Every clause, after removing the separator literal if present, must belong to at most one claimed component; any cross-component clause rejects the certificate.
Enumerate exactly the two separator valuations false/true; no hidden semantic shortcut.
For each separator valuation, restrict the CNF exactly and recursively solve every resulting component with the same proof-carrying rules.
SAT authority requires one separator valuation for which every component is SAT and the recomposed full assignment independently satisfies the original CNF.
UNSAT authority requires both separator valuations to be closed by at least one independently verified UNSAT component; otherwise return UNKNOWN_BUDGET.
If no verified separator exists, fall back unchanged to OSIRIS v2.1/generic search.
Discovery, graph construction, separator verification, boundary enumeration, component solves, recomposition and verification are all charged separately.
No fixture name, expected answer, Pyramid Text meaning, or external SAT/UNSAT oracle may influence activation or verdict.

tranception.BACK: Bind the S𓂸ḥ separator certificate, boundary table, child commitments and final verdict back to the exact CNF0 witness.
tranception.FORWARD: Independently rerun content-derived decomposition and solving.
tranception.LEFT: Same separator/decomposition capability on distinct CNF provenance must not transfer identity or certificates.
tranception.RIGHT: Same CNF provenance with separator certificate removed must block S𓂸ḥ decomposition authority and fall back safely.
tranception.FORWARD_AGAIN: Require deterministic equality of verdict, decomposition tree projection and certificate digests.
tranception.BACK_AGAIN: Remove all historical/project semantics; the technical decomposition/verdict must remain unchanged.

stop_conditions: Any wrong SAT/UNSAT answer on frozen calibration.
Any false articulation activation on frozen negative controls.
Any authoritative SAT without a recomposed assignment verified on the original CNF.
Any authoritative UNSAT without both separator valuations closed by verified component results.
Any post-hoc budget increase or threshold change.
Any regression of OSIRIS v2.1 pair-product or hard Tseitin gates.
claim_boundary: A PASS would establish only a proof-carrying exact decomposition lane for CNFs exposing size-1 articulation separators, plus the existing pair-product lane and generic fallback.
A PASS would not establish useful separator discovery of bounded size for every CNF.
A PASS would not establish bounded treewidth or polynomial quotient size for arbitrary CNF.
A PASS would not prove P=NP or P!=NP.
